notes:
- Multi-angle Tatami and Satin fill can finish near a mid-edge exit without a long sewn return after the cover.
- The stitch engine uses several direction guides together and keeps start and end markers independent. The new routing covers the return under stitches on suitable end caps.
- Improved Tatami travel around holes and Satin handling at sharp corners. Straight angle guides use their crossings with the outline to locate the stitch rows.
- Imported stitch previews and dropped artwork have been refined. Digitizing Lab remains available separately under Design > Digitizing Lab.
- A paired Tatami test with corner and midpoint exits stitched cleanly on linen. The curved-lettering precision issue remains open.
